title: Build and secure an MCP server
subtitle: Engineer an adapter with scoped tools, observable outcomes, and deployable contracts.
goal: Build a narrow server around a tested application service
intro: A minimal server teaches protocol wiring; production work adds identity, resource policy, lifecycle, and observability.
case: Expose synthetic help search through the official Python SDK.
The first server is read-only and has no customer credentials.
A decorator example does not implement remote production authorization.
